# P25Reflector-Dashboard2

> Live status dashboard for G4KLX P25Reflector amateur-radio talkgroups.

This website is a web dashboard operators install next to P25Reflector. It shows linked P25 gateways, last-heard callsigns, the current transmitter, and host CPU/disk stats. It is not a radio and does not carry voice traffic.

- Project: https://github.com/ShaYmez/P25Reflector-Dashboard2
- License: GPL-3.0
- Typical page: connected gateways, last heard, system information
- Config lives in /config/ (not public) after setup.php is removed
